title: The app is falling as I enter.
body: Used the app couple months perfectly, suddenly it started to crash when I open it. Tried to delete it and installing once again. The problem remains but now all my data is lost although I have a premium paid account and I was sure that the data would stay. And with all that there is also no option to reach the support.

title: Just what I needed
body: This app keeps clear records of how I'm doing.  I like the options of yes/no or length of time as the need calls for the habit I'm creating.  I like seeing the reminders if I'm behind schedule
author: Leahk18

title: Gorgeous UI
body: I love the look and feel of this app. I like all the options for different habits (categories, frequencies, colors), and I love the informal language. I just wish there was more feedback when I successfully check off a habit. A small "yay" message or something.
author: Tally H
